title: The Grunion Run, absent
logline: The night beach with the lanterns and the fish and, above the tide line where two figures sat for twenty-two years, sand. The page keeps their place with a lantern nobody holds. Two days after the two lanterns.

panels.composition: A night beach with lanterns along a silver surf line and, above the tide line, a patch of empty sand with one lantern set down on it and no one beside it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a night beach with lanterns along a surf line silver with small fish and above the tide line a patch of empty sand with a single lantern set down and no one beside it, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Their place kept with a lantern.
